profile_text.body:
Founders Fund is a San Francisco based venture capital firm. According to its own site, it invests in companies building what it describes as revolutionary technologies. The firm was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States. Its site carries a copyright notice covering 2005 to 2026 and states that Founders Fund is a registered trademark of Founders Fund, LLC. The site also carries disclaimers that past performance is not indicative of future results, that investments may lose value, and that nothing on it is an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy securities.

No AI products or MCP servers are listed for the firm. No lawsuits are recorded against it. Its recorded law exposure is in California, with a count of 281.
